items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: Sometimes he'd send Willie O'Connell in his place.

ctx.x: That was the last one worked with me after. Wooden Joe and Lawrence Morari. Sometimes he'd send Willie O'Connell in his place. I mean, in other words, he would work three nights a piece. One would work four nights, one a week, that one would make three nights.
Willie O'Connell is representative of the union in Beluxian, huh? Well, what does he play? Carlet? No, banjo.
